units.source_text: 如果说苍蝇喜欢腐败，那么鞠子也在开始腐败吗？

en.t: If flies are said to be drawn to decay, then is Mariko also beginning to decay?

units.source_text: 什么都不相信，这就是腐败吗？

en.t: Is believing in nothing what decay means?

units.source_text: 鞠子生活在惟有自己的绝对的世界里，才招来苍蝇的吗？

en.t: Was it because Mariko lived in an absolute world of her own alone that she drew the flies?
That was more than I could know.
